records.exactCapturedText:
L13: Sep 17, 2026
L16: Today, we are introducing the Life Sciences Verification Program (LSVP), which gives life science professionals access to our Mythos, Opus, and Sonnet models with a refined set of safeguards more permissive for biology-related work. We have already onboarded dozens of organizations through an early-access program, and are now opening applications to the broader life science community. The program is launching in beta, initially for teams and institutions.
L17: We will continue to improve the program and expand access to individual Pro and Max plans over time.
L18: The LSVP is designed to enable life science professionals to use our models across a wide range of tasks that are currently blocked in our generally available Fable models, like drug discovery, research biology, clinical development, and manufacturing.
L20: To qualify for these grants, each applicant goes through a verification process that includes a review of their research credentials, security standards, and ethical research oversight.
L21: Standard Use grants are suitable for most life science work. These grants can be extended to entire teams and are renewed once a year.
L24: High-risk Use is an add-on grant for teams working in areas blocked under Standard Use. It removes all safeguards that block life sciences requests. This grant applies to a single research project and must be renewed every six months.
L28: All other safeguards, such as cyber classifiers, will remain in place under LSVP grants.
L35-L36: Each entity’s access is tied to the use cases it has specified in its grant applications, and Anthropic says it continuously monitors LSVP traffic for activity outside the stated safe scope.
L39-L41: LSVP shifts safeguards from real-time blocking to offline monitoring. Anthropic says this requires 30-day retention for LSVP traffic; the data is compartmentalized, cannot be used for model training, and cannot be accessed by Anthropic life-sciences researchers.
L58: LSVP is available in Anthropic's first-party API console and Enterprise and Team plans. It does not yet support individual plans or third-party platforms.
L60: As a beta, LSVP is not available for BAA-enabled organizations.
limitations: Provider describes its own beta, vetting and monitoring.
No independent evidence of access quality, monitoring effectiveness, research outcomes or safety outcomes.
The announcement is not medical guidance or authorization to upload health data.
